name: 祥子与素世 · 长椅上整理发带

description.zh: 浅蓝色长直发，金色眼睛，黑色发带。
description.en: long straight light blue hair, golden eyes, and black hair ribbons.

description.zh: 浅棕色波浪长发，浅蓝色眼睛。
description.en: long light brown wavy hair and light blue eyes.

positive.zh: {{A}} 坐在白色长椅的画面左侧，{{B}} 坐在画面右侧。{{B}} 侧过身朝向 {{A}}，微微前倾。{{A}} 的上身略向后倾，但仍坐稳在长椅上。镜头从两人斜前方、与眼睛齐平的位置取景，画面从头顶到大腿中部，完整保留四只手和相互接触的位置。
positive.en: {{A}} sits on the left side of a white bench in the image, and {{B}} sits on the right. {{B}} turns toward {{A}} and leans forward slightly. {{A}} leans back a little while remaining firmly seated. The camera is at eye level, slightly off to the front, framing both figures from the tops of the heads to mid-thigh. All four hands and the points of contact remain fully visible.

positive.zh: {{B}} 用右手的拇指和食指轻轻捋顺 {{A}} 左耳旁的黑色发带，左手轻放在 {{A}} 的左肩上。{{A}} 抬起左手，松松地握住 {{B}} 正在整理发带的右手腕，像是在小声抗议，却没有把那只手推开。{{A}} 的另一只手，也就是右手，放在自己膝上，轻轻攥住一小撮裙料。
positive.en: {{B}} uses the thumb and index finger of the right hand to gently straighten the black ribbon beside {{A}}'s left ear, while resting the left hand lightly on {{A}}'s left shoulder. {{A}} raises the left hand and loosely holds {{B}}'s right wrist as if quietly protesting, without pushing the hand away. {{A}}'s other hand, the right hand, rests on the lap and lightly gathers a small fold of the skirt fabric.

positive.zh: {{A}} 脸颊泛红，眉头微微蹙起，嘴唇抿着，抬眼看向 {{B}}，表情害羞又倔强。{{B}} 看着 {{A}} 的眼睛，露出温柔、带一点得意的微笑，姿态从容。两人的脸保持适当距离，发带旁的手不要挡住眼睛。
positive.en: {{A}} blushes faintly, with slightly knitted brows and pressed lips, and looks up toward {{B}} with a shy but stubborn expression. {{B}} meets {{A}}'s eyes with a gentle, slightly pleased smile and a relaxed posture. The faces remain comfortably apart, and the hand beside the ribbon leaves both eyes unobstructed.

blocks.name: 画质、手部与双人结构约束

notes: 双人长椅互动：素世扶肩并整理发带，祥子轻握素世手腕、另一手攥住膝上裙料。身份和外貌保存在角色定义；构图、肢体、表情分别成块。先沿用现有工作流参数。已做模板解析检查，尚未实际生图。
